exclusions.source_text: Participant must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status (ECOG PS) of 0 to 2.
Participant has clinically significant, uncontrolled, cardiovascular disease
Participant has a QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula (QTcF) \> \> 470 milliseconds (msec) (for females) or \> 450 msec (for males).
Participant has a history of a primary malignancy that has been diagnosed or required therapy within 3 years.
